_README: Triage ledger for find-untested-cores.mjs. Mirrors the divergence scanner's ledger: it records a HUMAN judgment for each census 'gap' so the loop stops re-triaging the same glue every iteration. Keys are repo-relative paths. status: GLUE = DOM/canvas/render shell with no unit-testable logic; STUB = documented placeholder, no logic yet; DELEGATED = real logic lives in an imported/shared module that IS tested (file itself is a thin wrapper/barrel); GAP = genuinely untested LOGIC, acknowledged but not yet locked (stays visible as a known gap). Only GLUE/STUB/DELEGATED are suppressed from the loud 'UNTRIAGED' list. An UNTRIAGED gap = something NEW that deserves a look. Prune an entry when the file gains a direct test (the census warns you) or is deleted.

zanyplans/src/effects.js.note: Canvas overlay render loop (requestAnimationFrame + Math.random draws). No pure/deterministic logic surface.

translation/src/chatty-loader.js.note: Floating loader toast: DOM create + setInterval phrase rotation (rotate/updateProgressBar/setText). The small pure bits are guarded (empty phrases -> ['Working on it...'], loaders.size===0 early-return, progress clamped 0..1 with typeof-number+>-1 so explicit 0 is honored) — no extractable deterministic contract worth a lock. Read in full iter#7.

api/access.js.note: Thin edge login gate (runtime:'edge'). POST-only; guarded req.json(); returns {ok:true,dev} when ACCESS_CODE unset, {ok:true} on body.code===validCode, else 401. No extractable logic beyond the direct strict-equality compare. The ENFORCED server-side gate is _lib/access.js checkAccess, which IS tested (access-gate.test.mjs). Read in full iter#8.

api/cutter.js.note: Cutter chat/analyze HTTP handler (CORS + checkAccess + Gemini call). All prompt logic delegates to buildSystemInstruction/buildChatContents in _lib/cutter-prompt.js, which is tested (cutter-prompt.test.mjs). Verified imports iter#8.

api/qss-story-report.js.note: QSS story-report HTTP handler (CORS + checkAccess + prompt-assembly + Sonnet call). Verified iter#8.

translation/src/sentry-lite.js.note: Dependency-free error reporter. The one pure fn — DSN parsing — is extracted to sentry-dsn.js (parseDsn), which is tested (obs 5604). The rest is fetch-glue: uuid (Math.random hex), send (Set de-dupe + per-minute rate-limit + keepalive fetch, wrapped so it never throws), and window error/rejection listeners. No extractable deterministic contract beyond the already-locked DSN parser. Read in full iter#8.

translation/src/upload/media-flow.js.note: Upload/transcribe orchestration: uploadMedia (tus/signed-URL), runTranscription, uploadAndTranscribe — all async network glue over Supabase + the transcribe endpoint. hunter/src/db.js.note: Supabase CRUD wrappers (createProject/listMediaAssets/saveEmbedding/…). The one pure fn, normalizeError, was extracted verbatim to ./normalize-db-error.js, which is tested (normalize-db-error.test.mjs). No other extractable logic. Verified imports iter#14.

translation/src/db.js.note: Supabase CRUD wrappers. File itself is thin DB glue. Verified imports iter#14.
